title: Construction Adders, Frost Surcharge and Member Trenching Credit (Line Extensions and New Service Construction)
content:
Beyond the per-foot line cost, a **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** estimate at Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative may carry transformer, road bore, right-of-way clearing and frost charges, and on some classes a credit for trench the member digs. The figures for every class are set out below.

## Transformer and site charges

| Class of extension | Transformer capacity included in the line cost | Charge per kVA above the included capacity | Charge per road or driveway bore | Right-of-way tree clearing, per ft of overhead line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | 25 kVA | $48.00 | $950.00 | $2.10 |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | 25 kVA | $48.00 | $950.00 | $2.10 |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | 15 kVA | $48.00 | $950.00 | $2.10 |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | 50 kVA | $48.00 | $950.00 | $2.10 |
| Irrigation Well Extension | 0 kVA | $48.00 | $950.00 | $2.10 |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | 0 kVA | $48.00 | $950.00 | $2.10 |
| Temporary Construction Service | 0 kVA | $48.00 | $950.00 | $2.10 |

## Frost surcharge and member trenching credit

| Class of extension | Frost surcharge, per ft of underground line trenched in the frost months | Frost months | Member trenching credit, per ft trenched by the member |
|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | $0.00 | December, January, February, March | $0.00 |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | $5.00 | December, January, February, March | $4.50 |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | $5.00 | December, January, February, March | $0.00 |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | $5.00 | December, January, February, March | $4.50 |
| Irrigation Well Extension | $5.00 | December, January, February, March | $0.00 |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | $5.00 | December, January, February, March | $0.00 |
| Temporary Construction Service | $0.00 | December, January, February, March | $0.00 |

The frost months are calendar months 12, 1, 2 and 3 in every class. The trenching credit is for each foot of trench the member digs and backfills to specification.

## What each figure attaches to

- **Transformer** — only capacity above the included kVA is charged, at $48 per kVA. On the Irrigation Well Extension, the Three-Phase Commercial Extension and the Temporary Construction Service no capacity is included, so every kVA installed is above it.
- **Road bore** — $950 for each road or driveway bore.
- **Right-of-way clearing** — $2.10 for each foot of overhead line; underground footage carries no clearing charge.
- **Frost surcharge** — for each foot of underground line trenched in December, January, February or March; overhead footage, and underground footage trenched in April through November, carry none.
- **Trenching credit** — $4.50 a foot on the two classes that show it; the others show $0.00.

## Illustration (hypothetical installations)

- A hypothetical Permanent Residential Overhead Extension installing a 50 kVA transformer exceeds the included 25 kVA by 25 kVA, charged at 25 multiplied by $48, that is $1,200.00.
- A hypothetical Farm and Ranch Extension installing a 50 kVA transformer carries no transformer charge, since 50 kVA does not exceed the included 50 kVA.
- A hypothetical 200 ft of underground line on a Farm and Ranch Extension trenched in March carries a frost surcharge of 200 feet multiplied by $5.00, that is $1,000.00; trenched in April it carries none.
